scope: First feature block only; no fits or selection authorized by this draft.
attribution: Adapted from Alpha158 directional count and directional movement families. Use audited CRSP total returns instead of differences in raw closing prices.
input: r is the daily total return masked by the existing make_features ordinary return rule. Use an unbroken market-session index.
endpoint: Through signal close inclusive. Each window requires w valid returns; undefined denominators and incomplete windows produce NaN.
first_available: For each security and window w, the w-th consecutive valid market session (positive denominator also required). Research signals start 2015-01-02 using 2014 warm-up.
paired_design: Each listed candidate adds the screened directional block to its 33-feature incumbent. Match 0a five-day training and evaluation frequency, target, parameters, preprocessing and calendar. Process added columns with the same recipe as raw context columns. Phase 0b is a separate comparison.
adoption: Within each pair, require strictly positive equal-window mean IC difference and strictly positive IC differences in at least three of four windows. Ties do not count. No cross-family replacement.

screen.sample: W1 2015-2017; five-day signal dates, signal_eligible; no target eligibility or labels
screen.apply: One W1 screen shared across all four windows and three families. Later windows may only be diagnostic.
screen.existing: Protect all 33 base columns; compare each candidate to each retained non-market-constant column.
screen.order: family list order then ascending window
screen.correlation: Per date use pairwise finite raw values, average-tie Spearman, minimum 100 pairs, both nonconstant. Equal-weight signed daily correlations then absolute value; drop at >= 0.95 before rounding. If valid dates <90% of training signal dates stop for review.
